rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose attributive phrase for things connected with literature.

example.english: This book has a lot of literary analysis.
example.traditional: 呢本書有好多文學方面嘅分析。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 hou2 do1 man4 hok6 fong1 min6 ge3 fan1 sik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for people, groups, or work connected with the literary profession or literary circles.

example.english: They often attend gatherings in literary circles.
example.traditional: 佢成日參加文學界嘅聚會。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 caam1 gaa1 man4 hok6 gaai3 ge3 zeoi6 wui6
